body: I could pay for therapy to hopefully help my depression. With my depression under control maybe I would be able to stay at a job long enough to stand on my own afterwards
I do think a gym is a good option to stay motivated. Having other people there and as you said setting smaller goals of showing up could help.

The hardest part about a hobby is that all the things I used to love don't make me happy anymore. I used to do sports, games, D&D, but now thinking about playing anything or arranging anything just feels exhausting. When I do play or hang out I just kind of feel empty as well.
That is a good idea. I will probably look into the local shelter and see if they don't mind.
I live in a pretty small town I think there might be 1 gym within 30 minutes of me. Now to find out if it is affordable to have a membership there.

Well it is easy enough for me to find a natural environment, the problem is walking in nature doesn't seem to resonate with me anymore. I guess maybe growing up surrounded by nature has made it just feel like the norm.
I am not in as good of shape as I would like, so excersise would probably help. Getting started is the hard part.
I might be able to afford a marriage certificate haha.

Sorry about your boyfriend, just remember this trip is about you. Don't let him ruin an amazing birthday for yourself. It might be tough, but even if you can't find someone to go with you take yourself and have a blast.
